title: Networking Catacombs
description: Packets, protocols, IP addressing, and routing.

questions.prompt: What handshake mechanism does TCP use to establish a reliable connection?
questions.evidence_quote: TCP establishes a connection using a three-way handshake involving SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK packets.
questions.explanation: TCP ensures both sides agree on sequence numbers via the three-way handshake.

questions.prompt: Why is UDP preferred over TCP for live video streaming and gaming?
options: UDP has lower latency because it does not wait for retransmissions
questions.evidence_quote: UDP provides connectionless, best-effort transmission without acknowledgment overhead, minimizing latency for real-time applications.
questions.explanation: Real-time streaming prioritizes speed over retransmitting outdated video frames.

questions.prompt: Which TCP mechanism prevents a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver?
questions.evidence_quote: Flow control in TCP uses a sliding window size advertised by the receiver to prevent buffer overflow.
questions.explanation: The sliding window regulates transmission speed based on buffer capacity.

questions.prompt: What does DNS (Domain Name System) translate domain names into?
questions.evidence_quote: Domain Name System (DNS) translates human-readable domain names into numerical IP addresses.
questions.explanation: DNS acts as the Internet's address book.

questions.prompt: How many bits are in a standard IPv4 address?
questions.evidence_quote: An IPv4 address is a 32-bit numeric address written as four decimal octets separated by dots.
questions.explanation: IPv4 consists of four 8-bit octets totaling 32 bits.

questions.prompt: Which device inspects destination IP addresses to forward packets across different networks?
questions.evidence_quote: A router operates at the network layer to forward data packets between different computer networks using routing tables.
questions.explanation: Routers determine optimal paths for packets crossing autonomous systems.

questions.prompt: In the 7-layer OSI model, at which layer does TLS/SSL encryption operate?
questions.evidence_quote: In the OSI model, data encryption and format translation occur at Layer 6, the Presentation Layer.
questions.explanation: The Presentation layer handles syntax translation, compression, and cryptography.
